facts.fact: The Namibian Police Force's E-Policing eco-system, launched in 2010 per the minister, comprises 16 databases including case docket management, as reported by New Era on 11 July 2016; the article does not say stations enter cases in it.
The Ministry of Safety and Security launched the E-Policing eco-system in 2010 at a cost of N$22 million, said the minister on 8 July 2016.

systems.owner: Ministry of Safety and Security / Namibian Police Force
systems.tiers: 16 databases incl. case docket, crime statistics, criminal records, mortuary; stations not stated

systems.owner: Ministry of Safety and Security / Namibian Police Force
systems.tiers: operational in Windhoek only at launch; countrywide roll-out planned by end 2016

note: N-ABIS is identification and gives no fact; facts are taken from the description of the wider E-Policing eco-system.
